completeness.why: Four sites now pass their raw value to the existing exported getScheduledAmount, which decides missing/number/range; the budget template (which halves the rounded sum) is left untouched with its own isbetween ternary rather than carried as an explicit rounding-mode argument, so it is none (left out to preserve the rounding difference).

interface.why: Reuses the existing helper and only widens its parameter type to accept null/undefined, which is honest, but the one preserved inconsistency (the template's rounding) is not made explicit in the definition; it stays as a separate hand copy.

disguised_duplication.where: The four inlined ternaries are removed in favour of getScheduledAmount; the remaining copy in server/budget/schedule-template.ts runSchedule is left as it was, not reshaped.
